'''Bozzie Barada''' was a [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]]<ref name="PP" /> [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer pilot]] who represented<ref name="DB" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] in [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|the]] [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]<ref name="DB" /> of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Bozzie Barada was created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="DB" /> However, Barada was cut from the final product,<ref name="DB" /> and Barada's design was handed over to<ref name="TAoSWEI">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> the [[Gender/Legends|male]] Vulptereen [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]],<ref name="WsW">''[[Star Wars Episode I Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> who was known as "Bozzie Baranta" at one point during pre-production.<ref name="SWC:TP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

The [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']] features a character named [[Bozzie Baranta]], who is also a Podracer pilot. The characters have the same first name, and a very similar last name.<ref name="SW:EIR">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>
